Party Bus (28 Pax)

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. The Party Bus (28 Pax) is the most premium party bus in Arizona: twenty-eight of the most beautifully designed, most comfortable limo seats you will find, on an opulent wood floor, with two wet bars on board, and room for 45 bags.

About the Party Bus (28 Pax)

Fiber optic lights, bar lights, window lights and hub lights, over best-in-class subwoofers and a sound system to match. Every light switches on its own, so it runs as a nightclub on wheels or, with the lights down, as a clean executive shuttle.

Built for the bigger group that does not fit in a Sprinter: weddings, bachelor and bachelorette parties, birthdays, and any occasion that calls for everyone riding together.

Seats: The most beautifully designed, most comfortable limo seats

Party Bus (28 Pax) rental in Scottsdale, Phoenix and Paradise Valley: chauffeured by the hour from $250 with a 4-hour minimum, or as a one-way airport and event transfer from $550. Seats 28, room for 45 bags.
